settings.cover_alt: Melato Living Volume 01 portrait in a warm nocturnal interior
settings.issue_deck: A uniform made for the distance between a quiet room, the platform and last call.
settings.cover_note: A field journal of silhouette, transit and after-hours ritual—filed as a sequence rather than a catalogue.
settings.chapter_1_deck: The first move is not an entrance. It is the decision to leave, measured in quiet rooms, brown tailoring and the small rituals that make a silhouette feel lived in.
settings.chapter_2_deck: The uniform meets the public. Platforms, pavement and passing light make the line more active without asking it to become louder.
settings.chapter_3_deck: Colour deepens, texture softens and a familiar shape learns the grammar of dinner, conversation and last call.
settings.chapter_4_deck: Objects, gestures and residual light close the issue. The archive is not an answer; it is the material left in the room after the story.
settings.archive_deck: A finite contact sheet of outtakes, objects and afterimages. Select an exhibit for the record; the main story remains the primary route.
settings.archive_note: A recovered image from the edges of the issue: texture, gesture and a record of the time between scenes.
settings.shop_deck: Complete looks first, then individual pieces. Product availability is live; archive items remain clearly identified.
settings.close_note: Save this issue, return to the archive, or wait for the next field note. The collection remains available whenever the scene calls for it.

settings.styling_note: The jacket stays open to loosen the line; the pant preserves the silhouette.
A close, precise silhouette for the part of the night when texture does the talking.
The two pieces read as a complete uniform, but each can shift the proportion alone.
Filed as the final movement: a remembered proportion, a softened surface and one last exit.
